#load packages
```{r}
library(remotes)
remotes::install_github('thedunnlab/slcma')
library(slcma)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(robustHD)
library(DescTools)
library(corrplot)
library(rstatix)
```

read in data
```{r}
df <- read.csv('/Users/sarahlempres/Desktop/Academia/Yale/Yale Research Projects/DevTiming-SHAPES-SLCMA/B&E/Submission materials/DevTiming_SHAPES_GitHub.csv')
```

Cumulative effects of adversity on threat and safety learning and psychopathology
```{r}
#left amygdala
lamyg_cumulative <- lm(left_amygdala_Shen368_tvs_unreg ~ Total_Events + sex + age_at_scan + site_bin + aminus.bminus_mean_act_tvs_unreg, data = df)
summary(lamyg_cumulative)

#right amygdala
ramyg_cumulative <- lm(right_amygdala_Shen368_tvs_unreg ~ Total_Events + sex + age_at_scan + site_bin + aminus.bminus_mean_act_tvs_unreg, data = df)
summary(ramyg_cumulative)

#dACC
dACC_cumulative <- lm(AAL3_dACC_tvs_unreg ~ Total_Events + sex + age_at_scan + site_bin + aminus.bminus_mean_act_tvs_unreg, data = df)
summary(dACC_cumulative)

#vmPFC m25
m25_cumulative <- lm(Area25.AMINUS.BMINUS ~ Total_Events + sex + age_at_scan + site_bin + aminus.bminus_mean_act_tvs_unreg, data = df)
summary(m25_cumulative)

#vmPFC m24
m24_cumulative <- lm(vmPFC.AMINUS.BMINUS ~ Total_Events + sex + age_at_scan + site_bin + aminus.bminus_mean_act_tvs_unreg, data = df) 
summary(m24_cumulative)

#anxiety symptoms
SCAARED_cumulative <- lm(total_scared ~ Total_Events + age_at_distal + sex, data = df)  
summary(SCAARED_cumulative)

#trauma related symptoms
tsc_cumulative <- lm(tsc_total ~ Total_Events + age_at_distal + sex, data = df)
summary(tsc_cumulative)

```

Developmentally-specific effects of adversity on threat and safety learning
```{r}
#set seed 
set.seed(123)

#left amygdala 
Lamyg_dev <- slcma(left_amygdala_Shen368_tvs_unreg ~ Early_Childhood + Mid_Childhood + Adolescence + Adulthood + sex + age_at_scan + site_bin + aminus.bminus_mean_act_tvs_unreg, adjust=c(5,6,7,8), data = df)
summary(Lamyg_dev)
plot(Lamyg_dev, labels = c("Early Childhood", "Middle Childhood", "Adolescence", "Young Adulthood"))
slcmaInfer(Lamyg_dev, 1, method="selectiveInference")

#right amygdala 
Ramyg_dev <- slcma(right_amygdala_Shen368_tvs_unreg ~ Early_Childhood + Mid_Childhood + Adolescence + Adulthood + sex + age_at_scan + site_bin + aminus.bminus_mean_act_tvs_unreg, adjust=c(5,6,7,8), data = df)
summary(Ramyg_dev)
plot(Ramyg_dev, labels = c("Early Childhood", "Middle Childhood", "Adolescence", "Young Adulthood"))
slcmaInfer(Ramyg_dev, 3, method="selectiveInference")

#dACC
dACC_dev <- slcma(AAL3_dACC_tvs_unreg ~ Early_Childhood + Mid_Childhood + Adolescence + Adulthood + sex + age_at_scan + site_bin + aminus.bminus_mean_act_tvs_unreg, adjust=c(5,6,7,8), data = df)
summary(dACC_dev)
plot(dACC_dev, labels = c("Early Childhood", "Middle Childhood", "Adolescence", "Young Adulthood"))
slcmaInfer(dACC_dev, 2, method="selectiveInference")

#sgACC 
sgACC_dev <- slcma(Area25.AMINUS.BMINUS ~ Early_Childhood + Mid_Childhood + Adolescence + Adulthood + sex + age_at_scan + site_bin + aminus.bminus_mean_act_tvs_unreg, adjust=c(5,6,7,8), data = df)
summary(sgACC_dev)
plot(sgACC_dev, labels = c("Early Childhood", "Middle Childhood", "Adolescence", "Young Adulthood"))
slcmaInfer(sgACC_dev, 2, method="selectiveInference")

#vmPFC  #sig
vmPFC_dev <- slcma(vmPFC.AMINUS.BMINUS ~ Early_Childhood + Mid_Childhood + Adolescence + Adulthood + sex + age_at_scan + site_bin + aminus.bminus_mean_act_tvs_unreg, adjust=c(5,6,7,8), data = df)
summary(vmPFC_dev)
plot(vmPFC_dev, labels = c("Early Childhood", "Middle Childhood", "Adolescence", "Young Adulthood"))
slcmaInfer(vmPFC_dev, 2, method="selectiveInference")

#anxiety 
SCAARED_dev <- slcma(total_scared ~ Early_Childhood + Mid_Childhood + Adolescence + Adulthood + age_at_distal + sex, adjust=c(5,6), data = df) #middle childhood approaching 
summary(SCAARED_dev)
plot(SCAARED_dev, labels = c("Early Childhood", "Middle Childhood", "Adolescence", "Young Adulthood"))
slcmaInfer(SCAARED_dev, 2, method="selectiveInference")


#trauma related symptoms
tsc_dev <- slcma(tsc_total ~ Early_Childhood + Mid_Childhood + Adolescence + Adulthood + age_at_distal + sex, adjust=c(5,6), data = df) #middle childhood sig 
summary(tsc_dev)
plot(tsc_dev, labels = c("Early Childhood", "Middle Childhood", "Adolescence", "Young Adulthood"))
slcmaInfer(tsc_dev, 1, method="selectiveInference")
```
